name: Task_1
description:
Heat silicon to 2500K using molecular dynamics simulations with LAMMPS. Start from a crystalline silicon structure, which is replicated three times in each direction. The Stillinger-Weber (SW) potential should be used to describe interatomic interactions. Perform the heating under zero external isotropic pressure control using NPT ensemble. Heat the system from 300K to 2500K at a rate of 2.2 K/ps.

Use the conventional eight-atom mp-149 cell, and the supplied potential. Choose suitable integration and thermostat/barostat settings, initialize velocities at 300 K, and stop at the end of heating. Retain the final measured temperature in the LAMMPS thermo log. The system may remain crystalline or become liquid; melting is not required at this level.
submission_format:
Return a JSON object with the same keys and nesting as the example below.

```json
{
  "artifacts": {
    "lammps_log": "/workspace/output/log.lammps"
  }
}
```

Provide a native LAMMPS thermo table containing Temp in kelvin; other columns are optional. A single final sample is sufficient. For example:
```text
Step Temp
1000000 2500.0
```

The evaluator scores only the last row of the last thermo table. The temperature must be finite and satisfy abs(Temp - 2500) < 500 K. No trajectory, protocol history, or separate numerical answer is required.
